name: Dataset and Benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark for autonomous driving perception tasks, providing evaluation data for models.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision) and IoU-based metrics (task dependent)
general_score_metric: mAP (for detection) / IoU (for segmentation) / ADE/FDE (for tracking where applicable)
reputation: Used by researchers in autonomous driving perception for benchmark comparisons but less prominent than larger public driving datasets (e.g., nuScenes, Waymo).
notes: Multi-task benchmark with task-specific metrics; not an LLM benchmark. Evaluation and reported metrics vary by subtask, and results are sensitive to sensor setup and training data — risk of domain-specific saturation/limited cross-dataset generalization.
